title: Apex - Logistics & Supply
description: Unit supply levels and supply-vulnerability heatmap-derived risk, for logistics/resupply planning. Queries assume unit snapshots are persisted to a `units` table (id, name, side, supply_level, comms_status, position_lat, position_lng, updated_at).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM units WHERE side = 'friendly' AND supply_level < 50 AND updated_at = (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM units)
SELECT AVG(supply_level) AS value FROM units WHERE side = 'friendly' AND updated_at = (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM units)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM units WHERE comms_status = 'blackout' AND updated_at = (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM units)
SELECT name AS "Unit", side AS "Side", supply_level AS "Supply %", comms_status AS "Comms" FROM units WHERE updated_at = (SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM units) ORDER BY supply_level ASC
